name: game-document-transport
goal: A valid game document of up to 1 MiB saves and reopens over the local transport; phone requests stay bounded at 64 KiB.

evidence: Valid near-1MiB games must save and read through local multipart transport. UTF-8 byte limits, stale revisions, original modes and failure cleanup must remain consistent.

Existing transport used large responses but small requests; document roundtrips were ASCII and small. Extend the same standard fixtures with near-cap game requests, Unicode, permission preservation and replacement failures; retain phone bounds.

At b7139eb0c the standard repository and real-socket tests fail on mode preservation, Unicode overflow, replacement cleanup and a valid near-1MiB request. Cache-free normal entrypoints preserve valid snapshot boundaries.

Use a bounded local-only 1MiB plus envelope request limit on both ends, retaining remote defaults and frame caps. Save and read use UTF-8 bytes, preserve modes and clean failed temporary replacements.
